_comment: Sheet text -> BGG id. Use when bgg-search resolves a nomination to the wrong game (usually a same-name title from the 1960s-70s, or a stub entry with almost no ratings). Match is case-insensitive on the raw sheet text, trimmed. Add entries as they are discovered; Resolve-Nominations.ps1 warns on any match with year < 1990 or num_ratings < 300 so new cases surface rather than pass silently.
